tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: Page and screen background. Light: the warm off-white of the landing page. Dark: the ink used for the landing page's dark sections (calculator, footer).

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, sheets, input fields and anything raised off `ground`. Dark value is the card colour inside the landing page's dark sections.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headings, body copy, figures and the dark button. Reads on `ground` and `surface` in both themes.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: descriptions, helper text, eyebrows. Reads on `ground` and `surface` in both themes (at least 7:1 light, 9:1 dark).

tokens.name: subtle
tokens.usage: Captions, footnotes and units next to figures. Light value is the landing page's own: 5:1 on `surface` but 4.4:1 on `ground`, just under 4.5:1, so on a light `ground` use `muted` for small text. Dark value reads on both grounds.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: Dividers, list separators, card outlines. Decorative only: never the only edge of a control.

tokens.name: field-border
tokens.usage: Border of text fields and other inputs on `surface`. Light value is the landing page's own and is below 3:1 on white (about 2:1); pair it with a visible label, and use `focus` on focus.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The brand blue: primary buttons, links, active states, big numerals. Text in `accent` reads on `ground` (both themes) and on `surface` in light; in dark on `surface` use it for 24px+ text or fills only (4.49:1, just under 4.5:1).

tokens.name: accent-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed state of `accent` links and buttons. Dark value is an addition (the landing page has no dark hover).

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an `accent` fill. Dark flips to ink because white on the lighter dark-theme blue is too weak.

tokens.name: signal
tokens.usage: Signal yellow, the colour of painted bay lines: the eyebrow bar, highlight bands, the 'available' moment (slide to share). A fill, never text on `ground`.

tokens.name: on-signal
tokens.usage: Text on a `signal` fill, in both themes.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring: 2px solid, 2px offset, on every interactive element. At least 3:1 on `ground` and `surface` in both themes.

tokens.name: split-tenants
tokens.usage: Revenue split: the tenants' 40 % share, in bars and legends.

tokens.name: split-owner
tokens.usage: Revenue split: the owner's 20 % share, in bars and legends.

tokens.name: split-parkshare
tokens.usage: Revenue split: ParkShare24's 40 % share, in bars and legends.

styles.name: display
styles.sample: Jeres tomme p-pladser kan tjene penge i aften.
styles.usage: Landing page hero only. Scales down to 40px on phones.

styles.name: heading-1
styles.sample: Hvad er jeres tomme pladser værd?
styles.usage: Section headings on the web. Scales down to 32px on phones.

styles.name: figure
styles.usage: The one big number on a screen: earnings, price, revenue.

styles.name: numeral
styles.usage: Step numbers in a real sequence, in `accent`.

styles.name: heading-2
styles.usage: Card figures and app screen titles. The largest heading inside the app.

styles.name: heading-3
styles.usage: Card titles, list headings, FAQ questions.

styles.name: lead
styles.sample: ParkShare24 installerer kameraer og app, og driver det hele.
styles.usage: Intro paragraph under a display or heading-1.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Bilister booker og betaler på forhånd i appen.
styles.usage: Default running text and button labels (at weight 600).

styles.name: body-small
styles.usage: Secondary lines in lists and cards, nav links.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Form labels and small data labels.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Uppercase kicker above a heading, in `muted`, often after a 28×6px `signal` bar.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Footnotes and fine print, in `subtle` (dark) or `muted` (light).

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between a label and its field; between chips.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between buttons in a row; inside list rows.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Phone side gutter; padding of small cards.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Padding of standard cards and FAQ rows.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Padding of large cards; gap between card groups.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Vertical padding of web page sections. Not used inside the app.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: The small logo mark (28px).

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, the logo mark (40px).

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards and sheets.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Status chips and the slide-to-share track.
